_comment: Editorial content for SHSML. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available. Press mud fertilizer is marked as an R&D-stage product, as the company itself does.
description: Shahmurad Sugar Mills Limited was founded in 1979 and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It produces refined sugar, ethanol, bagasse and an organic press mud fertilizer, and states that it is committed to reducing waste and emissions through efficient use of resources and by supporting a healthy environment. The company describes itself as a leading producer of sugar and allied products in Pakistan.
